name: jira
description: Query Jira issues, sprints and projects. Read-only (Jira Data Center v2 REST API).

base_url.title: Jira base URL
base_url.description: e.g. https://jira.internal.example.com - no trailing slash. REQUIRED. The Python interpreter comes from the suite-wide EVA_PYTHON environment variable; this server touches no local folder. See the plugin README.

projects.title: Project allowlist
projects.description: Optional. Comma-separated project keys, e.g. 'ABC,DEF'. When set, every tool is confined to them.
